answer.company: Tesoro (Tesoro Anacortes Refinery, formerly Shell Puget Sound Refinery)
answer.accident_name: Tesoro Anacortes Refinery sulfuric acid tank explosion (November 22, 2019)
answer.reason: Exact match to CSB investigation details: six TK-1–TK-6 spent/fresh acid tanks, single RG-1 CO2 regulator serving TK-6 and TK-3 via 3/4-in hose through corroded nozzle hole, catwalk grating replacement with oxy-acetylene/air carbon arc, prior permit refusals for SO2 and LEL, UCR filed but not acted于
